title: BLIP-2
paper_title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
core_mech: Q-Former 的 learnable queries 作为冻结图像 encoder 与冻结 LLM 之间唯一可训练的视觉信息瓶颈。
core_mech_en: Bridges a frozen pretrained image encoder to a frozen LLM using a lightweight Querying Transformer (Q-Former) with learnable query tokens as an information bottleneck.
input_desc: 图像与文本配对，生成阶段输入图像和文本 prompt
input_en: Image + text caption (Stage 1) or image + natural-language instruction prompt (Stage 2)
output_desc: 图像条件文本或视觉语言表征
output_en: Fixed-length visual query embeddings and autoregressive image-conditioned text generation

source.title: BLIP-2
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

adapter.name: BLIP-2 (stage-two bridge architecture)
adapter.mechanism: Pinned Transformers BLIP-2 ViT, learned query tokens, Q-Former cross-attention, projection and frozen OPT causal language model; train only the stage-two visual-language bridge.
limitations: Canonical Apache-2.0 library implementation, not copied Salesforce LAVIS training code. All modules start randomly initialized at reduced dimensions; frozen random ViT/OPT have no pretrained visual or language knowledge.

Only the stage-two bridge architecture and causal caption loss are exercised. Stage-one image-text contrastive, image-text matching and image-grounded generation pretraining, instruction tuning and real caption data are absent.

Synthetic vocabulary replaces the original tokenizer. Vision initialization and learned query tokens use normal std=0.02 to avoid the library checkpoint-oriented near-zero/zero defaults. No image-captioning or question-answering capability is claimed.
